name: app-link-check
title: App Link Check
description: Check a domain's apple-app-site-association and assetlinks.json files and whether they list your iOS and Android app IDs.
author: sulhan_fuadi

commands.name: check
commands.title: Check App Links
commands.subtitle: Universal Links and App Links
commands.description: Fetch and validate a domain's iOS and Android app link files.

preferences.name: domain
preferences.title: Domain
preferences.description: Domain to check when no argument is given. Host name only, without https:// or a path.

preferences.name: iosAppId
preferences.title: iOS App ID
preferences.description: Apple team ID and bundle ID. If set, the check requires this app ID in the AASA file.

preferences.name: androidPackage
preferences.title: Android Package
preferences.description: If set, the check requires this package with a signing certificate fingerprint in assetlinks.json.
